# Hyperbolic functions

Hyperbolic sine, cosine, tangent and their inverses.

<h2 id="arc-sinh"><code>ArcSinh</code></h2>

```rux
pub func ArcSinh(x: float64) -> float64
pub func ArcSinh(x: float32) -> float32
```

The inverse hyperbolic sine: the value whose hyperbolic sine is `x`.
Defined for every real argument, odd, and unbounded in both directions. A NaN propagates and an infinity gives an
infinity of the same sign.

| Overload                                  | Summary                                                              |
| ----------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `pub func ArcSinh(x: float64) -> float64` | The inverse hyperbolic sine: the value whose hyperbolic sine is `x`. |
| `pub func ArcSinh(x: float32) -> float32` | Computes the inverse hyperbolic sine of `x` at `float32` precision.  |

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Math/Src/ArcHyperbolic.rux#L15)

**Parameters**

| Name | Type                  | Description                     |
| ---- | --------------------- | ------------------------------- |
| `x`  | `float64` / `float32` | hyperbolic sine value to invert |

**Returns**: the inverse hyperbolic sine of `x`

<h2 id="arc-cosh"><code>ArcCosh</code></h2>

```rux
pub func ArcCosh(x: float64) -> float64
pub func ArcCosh(x: float32) -> float32
```

The inverse hyperbolic cosine: the non-negative value whose hyperbolic cosine is `x`.
Defined only for arguments of one and above; anything below has no real answer and gives a NaN. The result is never
negative, since the hyperbolic cosine is even and this returns the branch above zero.

| Overload                                  | Summary                                                                               |
| ----------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `pub func ArcCosh(x: float64) -> float64` | The inverse hyperbolic cosine: the non-negative value whose hyperbolic cosine is `x`. |
| `pub func ArcCosh(x: float32) -> float32` | Computes the inverse hyperbolic cosine of `x` at `float32` precision.                 |

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Math/Src/ArcHyperbolic.rux#L53)

**Parameters**

| Name | Type                  | Description                       |
| ---- | --------------------- | --------------------------------- |
| `x`  | `float64` / `float32` | hyperbolic cosine value to invert |

**Returns**: the non-negative inverse hyperbolic cosine of `x`, or a NaN when `x < 1`

<h2 id="arc-tanh"><code>ArcTanh</code></h2>

```rux
pub func ArcTanh(x: float64) -> float64
pub func ArcTanh(x: float32) -> float32
```

The inverse hyperbolic tangent: the value whose hyperbolic tangent is `x`.
Defined strictly inside the unit interval. The endpoints are the poles and give infinities of the matching sign;
anything beyond them has no real answer and gives a NaN.

| Overload                                  | Summary                                                                    |
| ----------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `pub func ArcTanh(x: float64) -> float64` | The inverse hyperbolic tangent: the value whose hyperbolic tangent is `x`. |
| `pub func ArcTanh(x: float32) -> float32` | Computes the inverse hyperbolic tangent of `x` at `float32` precision.     |

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Math/Src/ArcHyperbolic.rux#L80)

**Parameters**

| Name | Type                  | Description                        |
| ---- | --------------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| `x`  | `float64` / `float32` | hyperbolic tangent value to invert |

**Returns**: the inverse hyperbolic tangent of `x`, an infinity at either endpoint, or a NaN outside `[-1, 1]`

<h2 id="cosh"><code>Cosh</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Cosh(x: float64) -> float64
pub func Cosh(x: float32) -> float32
```

Computes the hyperbolic cosine of `x`.
The result is at least one. Either infinity returns positive infinity, and a NaN remains a NaN.

| Overload                               | Summary                                                       |
| -------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `pub func Cosh(x: float64) -> float64` | Computes the hyperbolic cosine of `x`.                        |
| `pub func Cosh(x: float32) -> float32` | Computes the hyperbolic cosine of `x` at `float32` precision. |

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Math/Src/Cosh.rux#L11)

**Parameters**

| Name | Type                  | Description      |
| ---- | --------------------- | ---------------- |
| `x`  | `float64` / `float32` | hyperbolic angle |

**Returns**: the hyperbolic cosine of `x`

<h2 id="cotanh"><code>Cotanh</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Cotanh(x: float64) -> float64
pub func Cotanh(x: float32) -> float32
```

Computes the hyperbolic cotangent of `x`.
A signed zero maps to an infinity with the same sign, infinities map to `-1` or `1`, and a NaN remains a NaN.

| Overload                                 | Summary                                                          |
| ---------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `pub func Cotanh(x: float64) -> float64` | Computes the hyperbolic cotangent of `x`.                        |
| `pub func Cotanh(x: float32) -> float32` | Computes the hyperbolic cotangent of `x` at `float32` precision. |

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Math/Src/Cotanh.rux#L11)

**Parameters**

| Name | Type                  | Description      |
| ---- | --------------------- | ---------------- |
| `x`  | `float64` / `float32` | hyperbolic angle |

**Returns**: the hyperbolic cotangent of `x`

<h2 id="sinh"><code>Sinh</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Sinh(x: float64) -> float64
pub func Sinh(x: float32) -> float32
```

Computes the hyperbolic sine of `x`.
A signed zero or infinity returns itself, and a NaN remains a NaN.

| Overload                               | Summary                                                     |
| -------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| `pub func Sinh(x: float64) -> float64` | Computes the hyperbolic sine of `x`.                        |
| `pub func Sinh(x: float32) -> float32` | Computes the hyperbolic sine of `x` at `float32` precision. |

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Math/Src/Sinh.rux#L11)

**Parameters**

| Name | Type                  | Description      |
| ---- | --------------------- | ---------------- |
| `x`  | `float64` / `float32` | hyperbolic angle |

**Returns**: the hyperbolic sine of `x`

<h2 id="tanh"><code>Tanh</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Tanh(x: float64) -> float64
pub func Tanh(x: float32) -> float32
```

Computes the hyperbolic tangent of `x`.
The result lies in `[-1, 1]`. A signed zero returns itself, infinities map to the matching endpoint, and a NaN
remains a NaN.

| Overload                               | Summary                                                        |
| -------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `pub func Tanh(x: float64) -> float64` | Computes the hyperbolic tangent of `x`.                        |
| `pub func Tanh(x: float32) -> float32` | Computes the hyperbolic tangent of `x` at `float32` precision. |

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Math/Src/Tanh.rux#L12)

**Parameters**

| Name | Type                  | Description      |
| ---- | --------------------- | ---------------- |
| `x`  | `float64` / `float32` | hyperbolic angle |

**Returns**: the hyperbolic tangent of `x`
